analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – the app’s core benefit (knowledge of rights during traffic stops) is easily understood. Premium features are a reasonable mitigation.', 'Differentiation': '• Limited differentiation – many apps offer legal information.
